title: minuartia lanceolata subsp. clementei
intro: Minuartia lanceolata subsp. clementei, commonly known as the Corsican minuartia, is a plant species belonging to the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Minuartia lanceolata subsp. clementei include wound healing, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
